title: Best Enterprise SEO Software: Ahrefs vs Semrush vs Moz
description: Compare Ahrefs, Semrush, and Moz for enterprise SEO workflows, including technical audits, keyword and competitor research, rank tracking, reporting, team access, and pricing limits. Vendor plan details can change; verify the current scope before purchase.

faqs.question: Which enterprise SEO tool should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose based on the work your team must do and the controls it needs. Compare crawl limits, tracked keywords, historical data, API access, permissions, reporting, and total cost using the same sample sites and queries. The order on this page is a shortlist, not a universal ranking.

faqs.question: How much does enterprise SEO software cost?
faqs.answer: Costs depend on plan, usage limits, seats, add-ons, and contract terms. Ahrefs lists an Enterprise plan at $1,499 per month with an annual commitment, while Semrush describes Enterprise pricing as custom. Moz pricing was not verified in this update; check each vendor's current pricing page.

faqs.question: Are keyword difficulty and traffic estimates exact?
faqs.answer: No. SEO platforms estimate search demand, traffic, and difficulty from their own datasets and models. Treat these values as directional, compare trends consistently, and validate important decisions with first-party data such as Search Console and analytics.

faqs.question: What should an enterprise pilot include?
faqs.answer: Use representative sites and target queries. Test crawl depth, data freshness, keyword and backlink coverage, reporting exports, permissions, API limits, and how well the tool supports the team's recurring workflow. Record limits and unresolved questions before signing a contract.

author: PilotStack Editorial Team
body:
How to evaluate enterprise SEO software

Enterprise SEO teams need more than a long feature list. The right platform should support the size and structure of your site portfolio, the research your team performs, the reports stakeholders need, and the access controls required by your organization. Compare each candidate using the same sites, query sets, locations, and reporting tasks.

Ahrefs: backlink and competitor research

Ahrefs groups Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, and Rank Tracker in its SEO toolkit. Its current pricing page lists Lite at $129 per month and Enterprise at $1,499 per month with an annual commitment. Enterprise features listed by the vendor include uncapped API access, SSO, access management, audit logs, and unlimited historical data. Verify current limits and additional-user costs on the official Ahrefs pricing page.

Semrush: SEO and broader search visibility

Semrush offers keyword research, competitor analysis, Position Tracking, Site Audit, and additional search-visibility products. Its official pricing page lists the SEO Classic plan from $139 per month on monthly billing, with Enterprise pricing available by quote. Compare current plan limits and optional toolkits on the official Semrush pricing page.

Moz: focused SEO workflows

Moz is another candidate for keyword research, link analysis, and site optimization. Pricing and enterprise limits were not verified for this update, so confirm current plans, project limits, reporting, API access, and support directly with the vendor before including it in a final procurement shortlist.

Run a comparable pilot

Use a representative set of sites and target queries. Test crawl coverage, keyword and backlink data, location and device tracking, exports, permissions, and recurring reporting. Record which claims were confirmed in documentation, which were verified in a trial, and which remain unresolved.

Calculate total cost

Include the base subscription, additional users, add-ons, API or export needs, implementation, training, and time spent maintaining reports. A plan's headline price is not the full cost if the team needs higher limits or features reserved for another tier.
